title: Imported verification evidence
description: Externally asserted CI/verification evidence for an imported PR review. These are NOT locally executed controller run-check results: each entry records provenance (command, status, source) and the target SHA it was produced against so stale/failed/missing evidence is surfaced as a review gap and never treated as a passing local check. A list of evidence entries.

status.description: Externally asserted outcome. Only 'passed' may count toward evidence, and only when the target SHA matches the imported head.

command.description: The command/CI job that produced this result, for provenance.

source.description: Where the evidence came from (e.g. github-actions, jenkins, manual).

target_sha.description: The commit SHA this evidence was produced against. Compared to the imported target HEAD to detect stale evidence. For informational (non-trusted) evidence, accepts the full 40-character SHA or a hex prefix of at least 7 characters, case-insensitively; this is a PREFIX match, not a check that the prefix is unambiguous in the object database. Under --trust-verification (the only path that can satisfy the completion gate), the FULL 40-character SHA is required; a prefix is reported as stale. Anything else (a tag, a branch name, a shorter prefix) is reported as stale.
